title: Unit Event — The Phoenix in the Distant Sky

meta.Event: The Phoenix in the Distant Sky
meta.Outline: At the Otoris' suggestion, Tsukasa and the rest of WxS are set to perform in the Phoenix Stage's 30th Anniversary Show. What's more, they'll be performing a show starred in by Tsukasa's idol. Tsukasa leaps at the chance to audition for the same role as him!

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, we're all finished stretching and warming up our voices.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And I couldn't ask to be in better physical condition. Also...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right! Check!
Left! Check!
Front! Check!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Tsukasa Tenma is at 12,000%!
Now, onwards! To the Phoenix Stage!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeeeah!!!
Vroom! Vrooom!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think it's about time for me to buy a pair of earplugs...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. You two are much more excited than usual today.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Of course we are!
After all, today...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We finally get to discuss our joint performance with the cast of the Phoenix Stage!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We've been given a golden opportunity to grow as a troupe, so we absolutely should try to make the most of it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Still...
I really wasn't expecting such an opportunity.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You want us to do a show with the cast of the Phoenix Stage...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-Why this all of a sudden...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Just the other day, the decision was made to put on a “30th Anniversary Show” at the Phoenix Stage.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: And if you were to be a part of it, I'm sure it'd attract just that much more attention.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Between your night shows and ambassadorial performances, you've essentially become our flagship troupe.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Which means...
You wish for us to make this performance as spectacular as possible, yes?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But to think, a show to celebrate its 30th anniversary... The Phoenix Stage is much older than I realized.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, the Phoenix Stage was built not too long after this park was founded...right around the time I was born.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow, it has been here for a while...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: This joint performance should also be a good opportunity for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Especially since the Phoenix Stage is a renowned venue that even other parks like to keep an eye on. I guarantee that it will be worth your while.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll be able to take a big step forward as actors.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Wait, is this because...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And it wouldn't have to be ambassadorial performances. I am simply asking for more opportunities to do shows at different locations. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Is this their response to what I said about performing at different locations with other troupes...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, the members of the Phoenix Stage's cast are all top-notch...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... And they helped us a ton when we were putting together our night show. They even led the other troupes by telling them what needed to be done...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And of course, Seiryuin is a major asset.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: In terms of acting and performing, I believe you'll all agree with me when I say that she's a cut above everyone else.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: She's even been asked to join ArcLand in the past, and is so well acquainted with Asahi Genbu that they discuss acting on a regular basis.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sakurako's friends with Asahi?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Yes.
They seem to have first acted together when they were little. That appears to be when they first met.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In other words, great talent attracts great talent...!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: To be fair, Seiryuin isn't alone when it comes to possessing talent.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Because the Phoenix Stage has been around for so long, the cast has been able to develop a wide array of practice techniques. On top of that, they're all very hardworking. Working alongside them should be a good experience for you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that's true...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The cast members of the Phoenix Stage are all very good, with Seiryuin at the top. They're able to reliably put on compelling performances without any excess, if that's what you'd call it...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If I can learn to do what they're able to, I may be able to grow even more as an actor.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Then, there's no reason to refuse this offer!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Emu, Nene, Rui...
I'm hoping that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Say no more, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'm all for it!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me too. I wanna give it a try...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: All of you...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Then, we accept!
Wonderlands×Showtime will gladly join the Phoenix Stage in celebrating its 30th anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Wonderful...
Then, I'll let them know right away.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: This show means a lot to them as well, so try not to get in their way, okay?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Of course!
We promise to put on an incredible performance!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
That's good to hear.
Well then, do your best.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: We will!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Also, um...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you very much!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I've been hoping to perform with other actors in order to grow more...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But following the conclusion of our ambassadorial performances, as a cast member of Phoenix Wonderland, I thought I'd only be able to by participating in workshops and such.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I really wasn't expecting this.
I honestly don't know how to thank Keisuke and Shosuke...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I must make the most of this opportunity! I must grow again like I did with Thorpe and when we performed with Asahi!)
Phoenix Stage

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Today, your joint practices officially begin. I'm sure the others will be here soon.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Thank you for agreeing to do this, Seiryuin.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: There's no need to thank me.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I made the decision to have them join us because I want us to put on the best performance we possibly can.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I would've refused to perform alongside anyone lesser, even if such a request came from you two.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I guess that part of you is never going to change.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I'd be lying if I said that I didn't have a personal stake in this...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I adore Phoenix Wonderland, and they actually succeeded in saving it.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Which is why I want them to join us for this show.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Just like you two.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Excuse me... Sorry for interrupting, but do you have a moment?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Oh, is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: I'd like to discuss some things about that large prop we're going to purchase...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
I'll need to excuse myself here.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Of course.
We hope you'll make the 30th Anniversary Show a good one.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: We will.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I, Sakurako Seiryuin, vow to put on the best performance that you've ever seen!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: As dependable as ever...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Yes, to think that she's already the face of the Phoenix Stage at her age...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: And that she seems to have a pretty good idea what we're thinking.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: For now, we've succeeded in buying some time by getting them to be a part of the 30th Anniversary Show.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
However...
We won't be able to keep this up forever.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Shosuke, are you free later this evening?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Hm... I'm not, but I'll make time. For our sake, we need them to stay here for as long as possible...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: While we consider the future...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I agree...
Phoenix Wonderland
Outside the Phoenix Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, everyone!
Are you ready?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup!
We'll all go in and shout, “Come at us!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, we don't need to do that.
We're not here to pick a fight with them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But it isn't something we get to do every day, so it could be worth a try.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What?! You're joking, right...?!
It's our first day. Can't we just be polite and courteous...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's go inside!
On three...

Hah hah hah hah hah!!!
So, you've finally all arrived!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huh?!
That laugh! That piercing tone...!

Indeed! It is I!
The star and prima donna of the Phoenix Stage...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Sakurako Seiryuin!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We meet again, Sakurako Seiryuin!!!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Wait, why are you making it sound like I'm the villain?! I came all this way to welcome all of you. Can't you show a little more appreciation?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, right. They have their own Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Anyway, setting the games aside for now...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Welcome to the Phoenix Stage, Wonderlands×Showtime. We're glad to have you here today.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Let's do our best together to put on another incredible show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we'd like that very much...!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Alright, everybody's here.
I'm sure you all already know, but allow me to explain once more...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
This is Wonderlands×Showtime.
I've asked them to help make our 30th Anniversary Show one to remember.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you for inviting us!
We're honored to be working with you again!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line: Thank you for asking us to help with your night show! I hope we're able to put on another great performance together!

rows.Speaker: Cast Member B
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do our best to put on a show befitting of a 30th anniversary celebration!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! We promise to do our very best! Again, thank you for having us!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Alright, that's enough for greetings...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: We will now hear the details on what we'll actually be performing, as well as who will be playing which roles.

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(That was sudden.
Things feel much more serious now...)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: You should know at least this, Wonderlands×Showtime.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: We take things much more seriously than you may realize, so do your best to keep up.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Of course!
We wouldn't have it any other way!

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Then, I'll begin by presenting what you will all be performing.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
You will be performing...
“The Happy Phoenix”.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(...!
“The Happy Phoenix”?!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“The Happy Phoenix”...?
Hehe. That title suits this park so well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, and it's a pretty famous show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It is?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
It's a musical that comes from the United States.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The protagonist is a phoenix who lives deep within a forest. And one day, she meets a boy...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: His mother was cursed by a witch, so he began searching for the heart of a phoenix, which can dispel the curse and save her.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, without a heart, a phoenix becomes unable to resurrect itself. As such, the phoenix refuses the boy's demands.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The story unfolds as the boy begins to persistently ask the phoenix to help him...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow!
That sounds like a fun story! Right, Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Tsukasa looks kinda startled...)

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Now, as for who will be playing which roles...

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Our phoenix will be played by...Sakurako Seiryuin.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Naturally, she's chosen for the lead.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's a difficult role due to it being so demanding, but she should be able to handle it just fine...)

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Next, the forest's Great Eagle will be played by...Kenta Omori.

rows.Speaker: Omori
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(That's odd...
Normally, after the phoenix is chosen, her counterpart...the boy, Rio, would come next.)

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Next, the Cowardly Canary will be played by Nene Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: The Featherbrained Duck by Emu Otori.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you!!!

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: The Eccentric Crow by Rui Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: The Obnoxious Chicken by Tsukasa Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you...!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(The Obnoxious Chicken...
It and the duck are responsible for being the comic relief.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'll have to fully immerse myself into my character since we've agreed to be a part of this show...)

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: That leaves...

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Lastly, the witch will be played by Yukiko Nishie.

rows.Speaker: Nishie
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Lastly...?)
se_event_sky_2023_001

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Excuse me!
Nobody seems to have been chosen for the role of the boy, Rio...

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: About that... I haven't actually chosen anyone yet.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: After the phoenix, Rio is the next most important role. He will be a major factor in terms of how our show turns out, so...

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: I plan on making my final decision after holding an internal audition for this role.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: An audition...?!

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Starting now, please speak up if you wish to audition for this role.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: All are welcome, including those whom I've just assigned a role. In the event you are chosen for this role, I shall find a replacement for your old one.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Starting tomorrow, those who have tossed their name in will be practicing alongside the rest of the cast for one week. We will hold the audition following that period.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: If you wish to audition, please do not hesitate to raise your hand.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Rio...
We get to audition to play him...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (What a marvelous opportunity!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I, Tsukasa Tenma, would like to audition for this role!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Hehe. That's what I like to hear.

rows.Speaker: Cast Member C
rows.Line: Oh, I'd like to as well!

rows.Speaker: Cast Member D
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
I see five hands...
Understood.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: This is not something we normally do, but starting tomorrow we'll have the five of you take turns during readthroughs.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Understood!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He raised his hand without a second thought. I guess that's Tsukasa for you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. I wouldn't expect anything less.
Also, Rio's a tricky role that involves a complex set of emotions, so I'm sure it'll be a good learning experience for him.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'll be rooting for you, Tsukasa!
You can do it!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (“The Happy Phoenix”... The boy, Rio...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (To think I'd get a chance to play the same role that actor once did...)
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: ...which is how I ended up joining an audition for the role of Rio!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's awesome!!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, Tsukasa...!
It's cool that you're auditioning for it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Having to compete against actors from the Phoenix Stage surely won't be easy, so I wish you the best, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I promise to be selected for this role...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, to think that I'd get a chance to play this character...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...!
Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You seem a lot more motivated than usual ever since you heard we'd be doing this play. Why is that?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, she's right...
Do you really like this story or something?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, I don't think I've told any of you this before... I saw a rendition of “The Happy Phoenix” when I was in elementary school. Not only that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The actor I look up to was the one who played Rio!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! Really?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You saw a rendition of “The Happy Phoenix” in Japan when you were in elementary school, and the actor you look up to played Rio... Based on that information, and your acting style...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This role model of yours is Seiichi Amami, yes...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huh?! Yes, that's correct...
But I'm surprised you guessed with such little information.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. This is the kind of information that I tend to remember.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seiichi Amami...! I had no idea...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You know who he is, Nene?
Is he famous?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He isn't just famous. He's an incredible person.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Only a few Japanese people have ever had a chance to play a lead role on Broadway... And he's one of them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He's obviously an amazing actor, but he's also a great singer and dancer. As a result, he's received awards around the world. Lately, he's even found success as a director and playwright.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really?!
He sure sounds like an amazing person!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Because he is!
He is the definition of what it means to be a star!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He knows how to bring each of the characters he plays to life in just the right way, so it feels as if they're truly right there in front of you...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You can't help but be mesmerized by his performance. It's almost like...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Like how people stare at the stars twinkling in the sky.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. That's why you're so motivated. You have an opportunity to play the same role as your hero at a venue as big as the Phoenix Stage...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was already very grateful that we were asked to take part in the Phoenix Stage's 30th Anniversary Show...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But after I heard that we'd be doing “The Happy Phoenix”, it felt like there was a hand guiding me along...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which is why I vow to be selected for this role...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: On top of that, by a happy coincidence...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, there's more?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
There is!
It just so happens that Mr. Amami will be starring in a show at Tokyo Century Hall!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?!?!?!
We get to see one of his shows?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Really...?!
I kinda want to go since I haven't been to the theatre in so long.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah! I knew you'd say that!
Well, I also just so happen to have advance tickets on reserve!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'd like for you all to see this show, so I made sure to get four!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Wow...!
You even went out of your way to get tickets for us. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, but your audition's also really soon, isn't it? Are these two things gonna conflict?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Don't tell me you forgot to check the date...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah...!
Nonsense. There's no chance that the date for this show is going to conflict with...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whaaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That was fast. See...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, they're both taking place on the same day?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, the show's the day before the audition. However, I want to use every minute available to prepare for it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No...
This means... You'll all just have to go without me...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This is an unfortunate turn of events.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But... It's okay as long as all of you witness the star that I am trying to become...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, I've said everything that I was meaning to, so I'll be heading home now...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, you're leaving already?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I need to start learning my character for tomorrow! So, I'll see you later!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! He really zipped away!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
Tsukasa sounded super excited!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I hope he gets chosen for that role!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too.
Tsukasa's Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Alright, I've jotted down everything from the script in my notebook...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Ideally, I'd be able to watch a video of when Mr. Amami performed this role, but that won't be easy now... So, I'll just have to start by getting whatever insights I can from the script.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (An eight-year-old boy named Rio.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Red-haired with many freckles.
He's not very athletic and is often teased at school.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Unfortunately, his mother accidentally used the witch of the northern forest's favorite broom to clean and was then cursed to an endless sleep.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (As he has no father, Rio sets out to save his mother on his own with naught but a bug-catching net in hopes of finding a phoenix heart that can dispel the curse...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hehe. No matter how many times I read this, I can't help but admire him. I mean, he's setting out to capture a phoenix all on his own for the sake of his family...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, next...

rows.Line:
So...
Why don't you become the star of this show?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I promise to make this the best show ever by surpassing even you...!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Hehe... That's more like it.
Well, I'll be looking forward to seeing what you come up with.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I made a fairly ostentatious claim there towards the end, but I'm very short on time...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Will I really be able to figure out this character in less than a week? To get on the same level as Seiryuin...?)
Tsukasa!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seriously, why'd you run off like that? What happened...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, you're all here...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Apologies...
I had Seiryuin give me a few tips regarding how to get into character.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What...?
That's a pretty big ask. And she agreed to help you?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Well, to be clear, not using her way, but her friend's...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, I'm worried that I won't be able to figure out my character in time if I go with that...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Tsukasa...!
Is there anything we can do to help?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know we don't have much time, but we might be able to do something about that if we all work together...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To be honest, getting on the same level as Seiryuin as she is now will be incredibly difficult...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But you still wish to go through with this regardless...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Tsukasa really amazes me sometimes...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Even after seeing such an incredible performance, he's not giving up. I was convinced that it'd be impossible to catch up to her...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I wanna help too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I have to learn more...
I have to absorb what I can from Tsukasa and Seiryuin's performance...! So that I can also get better!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
All of you...
Thank you! I really appreciate it!
The next morning
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, do it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Aye aye, sir!
Rui, can I power it up now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. The time has come for the bird robot I made for our shows to rise once more...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As Robo-Phoenix!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Chasing around a flying robot...
Do you really think this is going to be good practice, Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He said the idea is based on the advice he received from Seiryuin... And I think it should prove effective.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rio has to chase the phoenix around for a large portion of the show, so I figured that I should try doing that for as long as I can! That may give me some new insights!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Here we go!
Power ON!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, it's up!
Time to catch you!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Grr...!
The way it moves is so unpredictable...!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Phoenix
rows.Line:
“Oh, done already...?
You sounded so confident about catching me just now.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh...?! Was that...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's a recording of my voice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The phoenix taunts Rio as he chases after her, no? I thought this would help make it feel more real.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
True...
I appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Phoenix
rows.Line:
“Too slow.
Honestly, where are you looking? Are you not going to catch me?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Rio's an eight-year-old boy...
Also, he's not very athletic and only has his favorite bug-catching net at his disposal.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (With that in mind, catching a phoenix sounds absolutely impossible. However...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (His mother's life depends on him succeeding right now...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Stop!
I'm going to catch you no matter what!”
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Are you okay, Tsukasa?
You fell a whole lot...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'm fine. Rio also falls quite a lot.
Also, I'm being careful not to actually get hurt.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know we don't have much time, but try not to push yourself too hard, okay? Here, use this bandage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But...
I still haven't quite figured Rio out yet...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I may not have actually made a connection with him yet. I mean, we're not in a forest, and the temperature and humidity feel completely different...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alas, I know that I can't ask for everything. We don't have time to visit a forest since we need to practice, so...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rio spends three days and nights surviving only on water...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, I shall do the same.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?! You're kidding, right...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: B-But... We're still practicing every day, and you have to play the chicken, remember? Just water? Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I fear that I won't be able to become Rio if I don't...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
...
Your resolve is admirable, Tsukasa, and I don't plan to get in the way of you becoming a star.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, I will stop you if I believe you're taking things too far.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, thank you.
Especially since there would be a negative impact on the show if I were to fall ill.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But... Until then, I'm going to push myself to the limit!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line:
Tenma, you're slowing down!
Try to keep up!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Grr... I'd be able to keep running if only I were at full strength...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Wince*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh no!
Tsukasa, you're really wobbly! Are you sure you're okay?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
S-Sorry, Emu.
I feel a little lightheaded since I haven't had anything to eat...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: At the same time, I think I'm starting to understand how hard it is to move while in a state of severe hunger...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I'm also supposed to have wandered into an unfamiliar land. Oh, I can try remembering what it was like when we were stranded on that desert island...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I know you can do it...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Wait...! Oh...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I... I thought I had you this time!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Why can't I catch you...?
Why am I so weak and powerless...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, that doesn't sound right...
He's feeling more than just sorrow here...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He's doing better than before, but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He feels that he's still missing something...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Still no...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'm trying to express how he truly feels, but...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I still haven't brought Rio to life...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Why?
What am I missing here...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (As much as I want to figure it out, I don't have time... At this rate...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No...!
I absolutely don't have time to think about that. I need to act! Now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Do not give up, Tsukasa Tenma!
I know you can do it...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Why can't I catch you...?
Why am I so weak and powerless...?”
Two days before the audition

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “What is your goal exactly...?!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I'm doing everything I can to catch you, but all you do is taunt and tease me!”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “You are mistaken...”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “The way you have been chasing me around so persistently... A very small part of me actually admires you...”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “Regardless of all the pain you are feeling, you still wish to save your mother?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“I do...
Which is why I need to take your heart back to her...!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(No...
All wrong...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Performing opposite Seiryuin inevitably leads to my character sounding artificial... No, more than that...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You've gotta be kidding me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She feels even more like a phoenix now...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I-I'm staggered...

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Stop there. Next.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line: I'll be in this next scene!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line:
“Wh-What am I supposed to do...?
I want to save my mom, but...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The others are beginning to distinguish themselves from one another as Seiryuin pulls them along...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (None seem to be the clear favorite, but at this rate, Tsukasa...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Not only will he not be able to reach Seiryuin's level, just getting the role is going to be a struggle...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Each Rio has its qualities...
They're all doing an excellent job of showing how frustrated he feels being unable to catch the phoenix despite his best efforts.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (What am I going to do...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I only have two days left...
What can I do...?!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa...
Tsukasa's Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Do I need to start observing what the others are doing in order to win this part...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'll surely be selected if I can show that my portrayal is even marginally better.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And after I'm chosen, I may be given more opportunities to polish what I have as we practice.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Which means, first and foremost, I need to come up with a way to win this audition...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No... No, that won't do!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's no point in winning this part with such a cheap portrayal.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because the kind of star I want to become is...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I've done everything I can...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I've thought about my character's background, how he feels, how he acts and moves... So many times too.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And yet, I'm struggling...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'm nowhere near Seiryuin's level, or the others for that matter.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (There's just no end to it, is there...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The shows we've done at the Wonder Stage, our ambassadorial performances, that show we did with Asahi and his troupe, the workshop I attended...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I clearly felt that I grew and made big steps each time I stood on stage.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Which is why I thought the same would apply for this show. I was convinced that I'd be able to keep growing.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (There are plenty of others just like me out there.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Not only that, great actors and incredible talent like Asahi and Seiryuin exist...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And that person...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(He's on top of the world.
Somewhere so distant and unfathomable...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How can I reach that place?
What do I need to do exactly...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, stop...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You won't be able to reach it if you don't extend your hand. You won't achieve anything...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Keep moving forward, Tsukasa Tenma...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Who could that be? It's so late...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh...
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What are you all doing here so late...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're really sorry, Tsukasa, but we thought this was our only chance!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
There isn't much time left until the audition...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But we've come this far.
So, why don't we think about it together?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A way for you to fully capture Rio.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Now I see...
I kept trying to figure this all out on my own, but...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It takes more than one person to put on a show.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I've been able to reach some great heights already because I've had them here with me...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The chances of the current me succeeding at this are exceedingly slim...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I'm not about to stop here...
Not while I have their support.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (As someone who's destined to become a future star...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I appreciate it greatly...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Until the day of the audition, let's do our best together!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Now...?!
You couldn't have picked a worse time...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. It just means you're aching for a bite, right? Make sure to eat something tomorrow so that you'll be ready to practice at full strength.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I'll bring a really big rice ball!!!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Thank you, Phoenix...
I'll never forget about you.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“For now, farewell!
I promise to visit your forest again someday!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: ...is how it goes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I still haven't been able to express what Rio's feeling, which makes my portrayal seem superficial... But I can't figure out what I'm missing...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I'd like to hear what you all think. Please, I'm all ears!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmmm...

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Hmmm...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO & Luka
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You did a really good job just now...
I'm not sure you did anything wrong...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I'm not sure either...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But it does seem like something is missing whenever you're on stage with Sakurako...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Rui...?
How do you feel?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This problem is by no means going to be easy to solve...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In terms of playing a character, this is one of your best portrayals to date...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You've taken everything that you experienced until this point, as well as Seiryuin's advice, and dug deep to become this character.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. I'm having trouble thinking of anything that's missing...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, once you reach a certain level, it becomes difficult to climb higher. This isn't exclusive to just actors...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As such, not many are able to break through that ceiling. So...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I agree completely...
You might've been able to find an answer, if only you had a little bit more time...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But we may be able to come up with something if we all put our heads together...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
Let's brainstorm!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Even a small idea might help...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (She's right. I'm willing to accept even the smallest idea if it means being able to find a way forward...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
This is so difficult!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
This situation we're in...
It feels a lot like the show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Which part?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Remember what happens during the climax? The boy finds himself at a total loss after struggling to catch the phoenix!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right now, you seem a little similar to the boy during that scene...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rio during that scene...and I...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (She may be right...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Why can't I catch you...?
Why am I so weak and powerless...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (My current situation and Rio's during that scene do seem to mirror each other.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (We both desperately seek something, but neither of us possesses the power to attain what we're after.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This sense of powerlessness that's welling up inside of me... If I can connect that to what Rio's feeling during that scene...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
That's it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What is it, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I... I just have to take a look at my phoenix...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh?
Your phoenix...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did you figure something out just now, Tsukasa?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes!
The chances are slim, but this may allow me to figure out my character...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
So...
What I said worked?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I believe it did.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(You can do it, Tsukasa...
I'm sure you'll be able to clear a path forward...)
The next day
Tokyo Century Hall

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's see... Row G, seats 15 to 18...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, found them!
These are our seats!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, I wasn't expecting these tickets to come in handy like this. You initially thought that you wouldn't be able to make it, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'm really happy for you...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Oh, he seems really focused...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (That means I should leave him alone!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It's been so long since I last saw Mr. Amami perform...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'll never forget what I saw that time...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (After that, he began working abroad, and even started receiving chances to be a director and playwright. As a result, I haven't been able to see him perform on stage much...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But I finally get to see him again today.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (At the same time...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'm not just here to watch the show and enjoy myself.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If this doesn't help me figure out how to play Rio, that'll be it for me...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (So, focus...!)

“Hm? What's wrong?
Why the long face?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That voice... Was it talking about me...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No, that can't be right.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But it sure sounded that way...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Ah, he seems to be trying to reach each person in the audience...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And he appears to be doing it effortlessly. That's quite a feat considering this hall seats 2,000 people...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (He's up there all alone with no props or anything... And he just started talking, but already has such a huge presence...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That person's just standing there all by himself, but he's so sparkly...!
“Alright, the curtains are about to go up.”

“By the time they fall again...
My hope is that you will be unable to contain your joy and excitement.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Such brilliance.)

“Curious...
Just seeing you walk is making me fall in love with this path. Just looking at the flowers that grow beside it makes me think of you.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (My eyes can't help but be drawn to him...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (With each word he utters, I look forward to hearing what he's going to say next...)

“Ah...
One day, simply seeing this land will end up filling me with happiness.”

“I'm exaggerating...?
No, I don't believe I am...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The way he smiles, where he looks and each subtle gesture... He's making all of the right moves...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He's bringing his character to life so organically... No, not a character! He's real...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(This is Seiichi Amami...
The person I look up to. A true...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (A true...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (When I was little, before I knew anything about theatre, he was who I admired.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No, perhaps even after I began to study acting... For so long, I was sure that I'd be able to get closer to his level.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (However, because I've been learning and absorbing so much lately, I can see now that...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Even a stage that wouldn't take me ten seconds to walk to...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It's beyond my grasp...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No... No, don't look away...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Do not let this sensation go...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(This sense of powerlessness...
Feel what it's like to be unable to attain what you are after!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No matter how much I practice... No matter how hard I try, I fall short of those around me...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I've been running and running...
But I'm struggling to catch up.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It's like that phoenix flying high in the sky...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I guess that is what you want to do.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (You want to reach that sky...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: T-Tsukasa, are you...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We should let Tsukasa be right now...
After the show

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: That was so good!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yeah, it really was.
It sorta felt like a dream, you know?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Here...
You can use my handkerchief.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Did you see that phoenix you were talking about?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I saw it.
The phoenix I'd been admiring, seeking and chasing after...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, I apologize for causing you all so much trouble like this...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I'm going to practice while this feeling is still fresh in my mind! Will you help me?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Do you really think we're going to refuse after coming this far?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, at this point, we're all in the same boat and it's already set sail...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
